title: Gravitational Potential
subtitle: "Ep=mgh"—this law also applies to social constructs.

items.text: Gravitational Potential
Mr. Wilson's patent transfer has been delayed now for three days. Today is the last day to sign.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: According to the agreement, we will transfer Mr. Wilson to headquarters immediately after the contract is signed.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But now …

items.speaker: Protester
items.text: Price gougers kill!!! Give us back our money!!!

items.speaker: Police
items.text: Back! Get back!!
A raging protest surrounds the Wilson Pharmaceuticals building, waiting for his car to depart.
Once the contract is signed, the only effective drug for a serious copper metabolism disorder will rise from $1 to $550.
For both sides, this seems to be their last chance.

items.speaker: Male Clerk
items.text: Hello, are you from the St. Pavlov Foundation? We're with Mr. Wilson.

items.speaker: Male Clerk
items.text: We'd like to ask you to accompany us to the signing location to keep things under control.
I'm sure you understand that is not our responsibility.

items.speaker: Male Clerk
items.text: According to the rider you signed with Mr. Wilson, the Foundation must assist Wilson Pharmaceuticals in the transfer of all property. These patents are the company's property.

items.speaker: Male Clerk
items.text: Please understand, we are only asking you to act in accordance with the contract.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I understand. We will do what we must to assist you.
Sonetto?

items.speaker: Male Clerk
items.text: Just you, Miss?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Nowhere in the contract does it specify the number of people that must be present during this transfer.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The Timekeeper has more important tasks, so this obligation will be fulfilled by me as her assistant.

items.speaker: Male Clerk
items.text: Of course, I'm certain we can trust in your capabilities as an agent of the St. Pavlov Foundation.

items.speaker: Male Clerk
items.text: Please follow me.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Not to worry, Timekeeper. I'll decide whether it is necessary to activate our emergency plan to protect Mr. Wilson as the situation develops.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You and Mr. X should take this time to make preparations for the transfer.
Sonetto and the clerks from Wilson Pharmaceuticals take their leave.
Everything is proceeding just as X said it would, yet the prophet himself is not present.
Instead, on the roof of an abandoned high-rise building, a lone figure stands against the wind.

items.speaker: X
items.text: "If there is an intelligence that can understand all the forces that bring vitality to nature …"

items.speaker: X
items.text: "And all the elements and things that constitute nature and their current states …"

items.speaker: X
items.text: "And this intelligence is great enough to analyze all this data …"

items.speaker: X
items.text: "Then from the largest object in the universe to the smallest particle, the movements of every body in time and space can be encompassed in the same formula …"

items.speaker: X
items.text: "For this intelligence, nothing is uncertain. The future will unwind before it with the same certainty that the past does."
The wind rustles the pages of the book.

items.speaker: X
items.text: What a beautiful discourse, Mr. Laplace.

items.speaker: X
items.text: It's just a pity … The butterfly has already flapped its wings.

items.speaker: X
items.text: When you were erecting that perfect machine, did you ever think that even the smallest gears might have a will of their own?
The protesters are gathered in front of Wilson Pharmaceuticals.
The rage of the crowd is growing to a fever pitch.

items.speaker: Crowd
items.text: Down with Wilson!!! Wilson has blood on his hands.

items.speaker: Security Guard
items.text: D**n it, we won't be able to get out …!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Allow me.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Sonetto takes a deep breath.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: May the peace be with us.
Then, she lifts her arms high—

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Via Pellar!
A simple and harmless arcane skill.
It grants a blessing to the road, so that Wilson's car is able to safely drive away despite the crowds.
The headlights come on. Everyone can only watch as Wilson's car speeds away, harmlessly passing through the crowd.

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: Useless whiners, what do these idiots know …?

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: It costs money to go to London, to develop a drug, to avoid the "Storm," to come back … Everything costs money.

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: Besides, why should I care about things like ethics when the "Storm" is about to wash away everything?

items.speaker: Wilson
items.text: I don't have time for this. Get out of the way, you stupid bastard!
Wilson pushes his driver out, taking the wheel of his car and slamming on the gas pedal.
Sonetto!
The smoke disperses.
The crowd has instinctively retreated from the crash, forming a large circle.
Smoke billows out from Wilson's black car. It has crumpled up like a crushed soda can.
A sudden and unexpected accident.

items.speaker: Crowd
items.text: … Oh My God …!

items.speaker: Crowd
items.text: Wilson is dead!!!

items.speaker: Crowd
items.text: He was crushed by his own company's sign falling down!!

items.speaker: Crowd
items.text: Seems like God finally took an interest! Hallelujah!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: How could this have happened …?
Perhaps it is only a momentary illusion. But it seems to Vertin that she has spied the fluctuation of an arcane skill not far way on an abandoned high-rise.
Yet, a second look confirms there is no one to be seen.
TO BE CONTINUED…
